findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess and shell command execution
 * @description Detect use of os.system, subprocess, or shutil which might lead to command injection.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/propcache/command-execution
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "move", "copy", "copytree"]).getACall()
select call, "Shell or filesystem operations that, if fed with untrusted input, could be dangerous."
findings.hypothesis: The PEP517 backend may invoke shell commands or destructive filesystem utilities in an unsafe way.

message.text: Shell or filesystem operations that, if fed with untrusted input, could be dangerous.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous shell and filesystem operations in pep517 backend
 * @description Find OS command execution and filesystem-modifying calls in packaging/pep517_backend/_backend.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/propcache/backend-dangerous-ops-context
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-073
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "packaging/pep517_backend/_backend.py" and
  (
    // subprocess and os command execution
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall() or
    // filesystem write/delete operations
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["rmtree", "copy", "copy2", "copytree", "move"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink", "rmdir"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Shell or filesystem operation that, if fed with untrusted input, could be dangerous."
findings.hypothesis: Identify concrete OS command execution and dangerous filesystem operations in the custom pep517 backend implementation.

message.text: Shell or filesystem operation that, if fed with untrusted input, could be dangerous.
